name: Robotic Arm
summary: Robotic arms are part of the game’s automation. When diagnosing sold needles, inspect all reachable belts: players report arms placing material onto nearby alternative routes.
version: Community reports (September 2026) and official store description

data.community: Observe the arm while its usual destination is backed up. The September discussion suggests that another reachable belt can receive material; this is player advice, not a confirmed explanation for every lost needle.
data.check: Trace every possible receiving belt through a scanner before the sell stand. Test the routing with a small flow before buying more arms.

imageAlt: Orange robotic arms surround a hay pile beside several conveyor routes.
imageCaption: Look at how close the arms sit to several belts. When checking your own layout, follow each belt an arm can reach. Official Steam screenshot.
